ESCAPED-BUG DEEP-DIVE — tie-together (2026-08-18). The escaped-bug analysis (43 regression bugs; 8 genuine defect-matches) produced two workstreams:

LANDED LOCALLY (not yet pushed to Gerrit): 4 code-v3 threshold flips in criteria_routing.json — api-compat->blocking@0.51, deletion-impact->blocking@0.60, regression->blocking@0.54 (new key), error-handling->blocking@0.50 (new key) — plus 3 governance-pin tests updated to the 7-member blocking set; 713 targeted tests pass. Gerrit landing ceremony still pending operator go-ahead.

DISCOVERED WORK (all user-approved designs recorded on their own tickets):
- reflective-central-sponge — verifier recall/impact scoring: (a1) freq_mult amplify-only reshape [1.0..1.x] so new/quiet files never discount a finding; (a2) version-signal gating of unversioned_published_contract_break; (a3) pass-2 removed-symbol question keyed on the EXPORT not a cited caller. Grounded in citric-preregal-ladybird (0.30->0.60) and brattish-ladyish-jaguar (validity 0.4286).
- unaroused-undead-ibisbill — CI-gate-compat: portable multi-CI applies_to glob lens (no hard-coded .github/workflows), CI-agnostic verifier prompt, config-overridable glob set.
- cherubic-content-woodpecker — import-integrity: clean-wheel import-smoke over every submodule with all optional-extras (measured 404 modules / 0.78s; ~1-2s marginal on the existing golden-path job). APPROVED.
- restoring-shallow-blobfish — surface-parity: design revised to Pattern A (single-source-of-truth + generation) after the parity experiment showed signature-introspection false-positives + a runtime close_class blind spot. A deeper-dive on migration impact/regression-risk is in progress before the design is finalized on that ticket.
